components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (one of MR, MRS, MS or DR).
            When supplied it is prefixed to the lastName to form the
            'salutation'. Omitted or empty when the owner has no title.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' (and optional
            'addressLine2') fields are supplied they are preferred and this flat
            value is ignored. On read it is returned as the composed, normalized
            address: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and the
            normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address (street
            number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied; an
            owner is valid when it provides an address in either form (a non-blank
            'addressLine1' or the flat 'address') plus a city. Normalized like the
            flat address (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common
            street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            An optional second line of the structured postal address (unit,
            apartment, etc.). When present it is normalized like addressLine1 and
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. The value is normalized into
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+'
            and country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must contain 8 to 15 digits after the '+'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 3
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional;
            when supplied it is used to derive the owner's ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be
            four digits and, when the owner's city has a known region
            (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), fall within that
            region's postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD
            4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household with an existing owner. Retained for contract compatibility
            but now inert: an owner sharing another owner's lastName and postcode is
            always admitted as a household member (its membershipLevel capped at one
            above the highest level among the existing members), so the former
            household-duplicate rejection this flag used to bypass no longer exists.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 derived identity, grouping the three identifiers
        that are all rederived by the version-2 algorithm (a fixed 'V2' version
        tag mixed inside each), so no value produced under version 1 is produced
        again. The 'V2' tag lives only inside these identifiers, never in the
        plain 'locality', 'timezone' or owner-segment region.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified version-2 member identifier, formatted
            '<V2><REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': a fixed 'V2' version tag prefixes the
            plain REGION code derived from the postcode, FY is the two-digit
            fiscal year of the registrationDate (fiscal year starts 1 July),
            HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
            (normalizedTelephone + lastName), and CHK is a single Luhn check
            digit computed over the digits of '<V2><REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW263A7F9C2E7'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            Deterministic version-2 identifier shared by owners in the same
            household: the first 12 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
            ('V2' + '|' + normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode), so owners with the
            same lastName and postcode share it automatically. Null for owners
            that have no postcode (and therefore no household).
          type: string
          example: '3A7F9C2E1B4D'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The derived version-2 key used to detect duplicate owners: the
            lower-case SHA-256 hex digest over
            ('V2' + '|' + <normalizedTelephone> + '|' + <lowerEmail> + '|' +
            <soundex(lastName)>). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole
            identity keys are equal; a create with an identity key already used by
            another (non-deleted) owner is rejected with 409 Conflict.
          type: string
          example: '9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08'
          readOnly: true
      readOnly: true
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical relative URL of this owner, formed as '/api/owners/'
                followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the title and lastName separated by a
                single space (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just the lastName when the
                owner has no title.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code,
                a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract represented by this
                response. Always 2: the memberId, identityKey and householdId are
                grouped under the nested 'identity' object and are derived by the
                version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted)
                registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is labelled by the calendar year in which it ends. Null when no
                registrationDate is set.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that shared the same firstName and
                lastName (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was
                created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, computed from stored fields: start
                at 0, add 2 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is
                0, add 2 for a household of 3 or more, and add 3 for a tenure of
                at least one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints:
                1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5 points, and 4 for 6
                or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The '<REGION>' component of the owner's memberId (the region code
                derived from the postcode), or 'UNKNOWN' when no memberId is assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region (the
                '<REGION>' component of its memberId) via the
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or null when the
                region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'.
                AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known region (NSW,
                VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been created (registered)
                on the current day, signalling an unusually high daily signup volume;
                false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive), signalling that it is approaching the per-city capacity
                limit of 50; false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate measured against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Null when no birthDate is supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner was flagged as a suspected soft-duplicate: set
                true at create time when the owner's identityKey differs from
                every existing owner's (so it is not a hard 409 duplicate) yet it
                shares an existing, non-deleted owner's soundex(lastName) and
                postcode. The matched owner is reported in possibleDuplicateOf.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The ID of the existing owner this owner soft-matches, set when
                possibleDuplicate is true; null otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                Aggregate risk indicator, true when any single risk signal holds:
                the owner is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true), the
                email domain is disposable-adjacent (it shares a label with a known
                disposable domain — e.g. a subdomain of one or the same base name
                under a different TLD — without being on the blocklist itself), or
                the owner's city is over its soft capacity (it already holds at least
                the per-city soft-capacity threshold of 40 owners); false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. False for a newly created
                owner; deleting an owner (DELETE /api/owners/{id}) flags this true and
                retains the record. Deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
